title: Enable QR Control on a display
summary: Turn on QR Control for one display so visitors can scan the code on screen and use their phone as a remote control for its triggered campaigns.
bodyMd:
QR Control puts a QR code on a display. A visitor scans it and their phone becomes a remote control: they see the triggered campaigns running on that display and can start any of them, with the experience kept in sync between phone and screen. You enable it per display on the Enabled Features tab. Allow about 2 minutes.

Before you begin

  • An HQ Admin account with permission to manage displays and devices.
  • QR Control is enabled for the organisation under Platform Admin → Enabled Features → QR Control, and the default QR code settings are set. See Enable QR Control and set the default QR code settings.
  • At least 1 triggered campaign is set up to play on the display. See What are triggered campaigns?.

Steps

  1. In the left navigation, select Displays & Devices.
  2. Select the display's Name.
  3. Select the Enabled Features tab.
  4. Tick Enable QR Control. The QR settings for this display appear.
  5. If this display needs different settings from the default, set Size (in px), Qr Code Colour and Connected Icon/Logo Colour.
  6. In QR Control - Mobile Site Template, choose the mobile site template a visitor sees after scanning.
  7. Select Save Changes.

Verify it worked

The display shows a QR code in the position and size you set. In Displays & Devices, the display's Enabled Features column shows the QR icon. Scan the code with a phone: the mobile site opens and lists the triggered campaigns on that display.

Troubleshooting

No QR code appears on the screen

Cause. QR Control is off at the organisation level, or the display has no active triggered campaign.

Fix. Turn on Enable QR-Control on Connected Store Displays under Platform Admin → Enabled Features → QR Control, then confirm a triggered campaign is targeted at this display.

Related

  • Change the QR code size, colour or position on a display
  • Let a visitor join the queue by scanning a QR code on a display
  • Assign a different mobile site template to a store, display or zone
  • Enable chatbot interactions on a display or mobile site
